entities.summary: Junichi Tazawa  is a Japanese former professional baseball pitcher who last played for ENEOS of the Japanese Industrial League. He also previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox, Miami Marlins, and Los Angeles Angels, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Wei Chuan Dragons.
